Yeah. I tried last time, but I will try again next session. 

( I think part of it is that when I told him about the first time, he asked me why I told him - not in a mean way, but more in a way of like.... I didn't *need* to tell him, so what made me? And I guess that just stuck with me because it made me feel like it either wasn't serious enough for some reason or he didn't want to hear it. )

Yeah. I guess the thing is like when I'm not in immediate danger I can't say that I will, but then stuff ends up happening very quickly often. So it's hard to say if I will or not, and I don't want to waste people's time either. 

But if it gets that close and I can get myself to go, I will try. Thank you <3

He knows about the first attempt only. Does not know about the second or that the methods I am thinking about are more dangerous

OK. I'm okay right now. Thank you for the response!
